history.text: By oral history founded in the late 15th century by Kwada Kwakaa, a prince and hunter; the name comes from the Kamwe for “the hills where Kwada Kwakaa goes stealthily to hunt”. Across the border lies Rhumsiki in Cameroon.

summary.text: The Kamwe, formerly called Higi, are the principal people of Michika LGA in northern Adamawa, in the Mandara hills. They speak Vecemwe, a Biu-Mandara (Chadic) language.

areas.note: 'The principal ethnic group and language in Mwecika (Michika) is the Kamwe people'.
